prompt: Every image has alt text describing it for people who can't see it.
why: Alt text lets screen readers describe images. That's accessibility.
trap: It's an HTML attribute, but its purpose is access.

prompt: Each input has a label so a screen reader announces what to type.
tells: so a screen reader announces what to type
why: Labels make forms usable for everyone.
trap: It's a form, but the clue is the screen reader.

prompt: The whole menu can be used with the keyboard alone.
why: Keyboard access is part of accessibility.
trap: Keys fire events, but the goal is access.

prompt: Light grey text on white fails because it's too hard to read.
why: Enough colour contrast is part of accessibility.
trap: It's a CSS colour, but the issue is readability.

prompt: Someone removed the focus outline, so keyboard users lose track of where they are.
why: Visible focus is needed for keyboard users. That's accessibility.
trap: It's a style change, but the harm is access.

prompt: A button with only an icon gets an aria-label so it has a name.
why: Giving controls a name for assistive tech is accessibility.
trap: It's an attribute, but the purpose is access.
